lines.t: We don’t move for the show.
Chrome on the nails, got my feet on the ground,
Whole room talks, I don’t chase that sound.
Big-screen smiles with a counterfeit core—
Had that life, don’t want it anymore.
Put my own pride in the rearview,
Said “I was wrong”—that’s a real move.
No perfect pose, no polished disguise,
God knows the heart underneath this ice.
Let what I do match what I say.
Past the satellites, You know my name,
Every hidden motive, every borrowed claim.
I can fool the room, but I can’t fool You—
Take this whole heart, make the next step true.
Heart check! Who you answering to?
Big step! Let your walk come through.
If I say I trust Him, let it show.
Hands up high, ego down low—
Turn that talk into a walk, let’s go!
Oh-eh-oh, let the whole room know,
Heart check! Let the real thing show.
Who gets the credit when the numbers go up?
Who am I calling when it all blows up?
Not gonna turn my faith to a fashion,
Not gonna sell you a caption for action.
I owe you an apology, not a photo shoot.
Mercy in motion, I’m making that call—
Can’t say “love” then ignore your fall.
No rented halo for the close-up.
Then live it when nobody’s there to press “yes.”
Orbit the hype? Nah, changing my course.
God at the center, not crowd applause.
Bass goes boom, but the choice stays mine:
Do I mean these words when the sound cuts out?
Heart check! Who you answering to?
Big step! Let your walk come through.
If I say I trust Him, let it show.
Hands up high, ego down low—
Turn that talk into a walk, let’s go!
Oh-eh-oh, let the whole room know,
Heart check! Let the real thing show.
